task_completion.description: Open the initial floor plan '3rd_floor_plan.drawio' in the diagramming tool.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Draw.io/diagrams.net interface is visible showing a floor plan with approximately 15 rooms.

task_completion.description: Add the specific title and label all 15+ rooms according to the Room Schedule.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The title '3rd Floor Emergency Evacuation Plan — Building C' is visible. Rooms are labeled with numbers (e.g., 301-308) and names (e.g., Server, Kitchen, Reception).

task_completion.description: Place red 'EXIT' labels, red Fire Extinguisher symbols, and green First Aid symbols.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Red text 'EXIT' is visible at exits. Red icons/shapes for fire extinguishers and green icons/shapes for first aid kits are placed throughout the floor plan.

task_completion.description: Draw primary (solid green arrows) and secondary (dashed orange arrows) evacuation routes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Solid green arrows and dashed orange arrows are visible on the floor plan pointing toward exits.

task_completion.description: Include a Legend/Key and an 'Assembly Point' annotation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A legend box explaining the arrows and symbols is present. An 'Assembly Point' label is visible on the diagram.

task_completion.description: Export the final diagram as a PDF to the specified location.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The export dialog or a file manager showing '3rd_floor_evacuation.pdf' in the '~/Diagrams/' directory.

integrity.description: The agent used the diagramming software GUI to edit the plan rather than just creating a file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Draw.io tools, dragging shapes, or typing labels in the app.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename the original file or copy a pre-made image.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the progressive addition of arrows, symbols, and text to the base floor plan.

integrity.description: The agent actually opened the requirements text file to verify details.
integrity.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window is seen displaying the contents of 'evacuation_plan_requirements.txt'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The source file is at ~/Diagrams/3rd_floor_plan.drawio and the output must be ~/Diagrams/3rd_floor_evacuation.pdf. The plan must contain at least 15 room labels (including 301-308, Server, Kitchen, Reception, Conference, Restroom). It requires at least 8 evacuation route edges (arrows). The title must be exactly '3rd Floor Emergency Evacuation Plan — Building C'. Primary routes must be solid green; secondary must be dashed orange.
